name: What is the process for coordinating tile installation with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for coordinating tile installation with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and project requirements. We then assist with tile selection and design, followed by a detailed proposal including a timeline and budget. Once approved, we manage all logistics, including ordering materials, scheduling our installation team, and coordinating with other contractors on-site. Regular updates are provided throughout the installation until completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our coordination process involves consultation, design and tile selection, a detailed proposal, and full project management through to completion.
